mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_log (log_id, user_wallet_id, amount, type, method) VALUES (wallet_log_seq.NEXTVAL, #{userWalletId}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{method})
mapper.select: SELECT log_id, user_wallet_id, amount, type, method, created_at FROM wallet_log WHERE user_wallet_id = #{userWalletId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
